member.summary: Decodes the buffer as a real image (rejecting anything that isn't, regardless of what its extension claimed) and enforces the pixel-dimension bounds the header's fixed logo box is designed around. Leaves rewound to 0.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.Branding.Application.BrandingService.ResizeIfOversized(System.IO.MemoryStream)
member.summary: Downscales a raster logo whose longer edge exceeds StoredLogoDimensionPx, preserving aspect ratio and the original format (so a transparent PNG stays PNG, etc.). Returns null when the upload is already small enough — nothing to do, caller stores the original bytes. Assumes ValidateRasterImage has already confirmed this decodes cleanly. Leaves rewound to 0 either way.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.Branding.Application.BrandingService.ValidateSvg(System.IO.MemoryStream)
member.summary: SVG is vector, not decodable by an image library — this validates it as real markup instead, walking the parsed element/attribute tree rather than string-matching a single literal (" (browsers don't execute embedded script for that element), so this is defense-in-depth against the file being opened by direct navigation, not the only thing standing between an uploaded SVG and script execution.

member.summary: Defense in depth alongside idempotent creation-on-read: a fresh database (or one where the row was somehow deleted) still gets a working default row on the very next read, matching the app's pre-feature static config defaults exactly.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.Branding.Endpoints.BrandingController
member.summary: The Branding module's HTTP surface — get/update the current theme configuration and upload a hospital logo, per the Theme & Branding settings feature. Every action requires a Hospital JWT (the default FallbackPolicy) so the tenant-aware BrandingDbContext can resolve which hospital's own branding row to read/write — see docs/DecisionLog.md. The pre-login screen no longer calls this endpoint at all; it themes itself with the static frontend defaults instead (no tenant is known yet at that point). "Actor" (updated-by) is read from the caller's JWT via ClaimsPrincipalExtensions.GetUserId. Get is deliberately left at bare [Authorize] — every authenticated user of any role needs it to theme the app after login, not just Settings admins. Update/ UploadLogo additionally require identity-administration.edit (reusing the existing "Roles, Users & Settings" category — see ModuleCatalog/ROLE_MODULES rather than adding a new one, matching Masters' own reuse of this module for its Settings-adjacent pages) so a non-admin authenticated user can no longer rewrite tenant-wide branding by calling the API directly — see docs/DecisionLog.md ADR-074.
